note: Moonshot's September 23, 2026 refresh of July's Kimi K3 — same 2.8T LatentMoE open-weights skeleton (Modified MIT), same $3/$15 API, two months of post-training work on the agentic rows. The launch table is conservative: +1-3 points almost everywhere with the biggest moves on Terminal-Bench 3 (17.4 → 21.8) and ExploitBench (32.2 → 36.7). No weights-size change, no price change — an iterate-in-place release rather than a new tier. The K3 family's fast tier (K3-Fast) is untouched.
